{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Inspect missing values
print(penguins.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print('\nDuplicate rows:', penguins.duplicated().sum())

# Check distribution of key variables
print('\nSpecies distribution:\n', penguins['species'].value_counts())
print('\nIsland distribution:\n', penguins['island'].value_counts())
print('\nSex distribution:\n', penguins['sex'].value_counts())"}
